FAQs on Hiring AI Experts

How much does it cost to hire an AI developer?

The price depends on your project’s complexity and urgency and the location of AI engineers. Check average annual salaries in our post on team extension and book a free consultation to get a cost estimate of your future hires.

Which skills are critical for an Artificial Intelligence engineer?

AI developers must know several programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, R), large datasets (Hadoop, AWS S3, Apache Spark), ML models (CNNs, RNNs), cloud-based AI and ML services (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform), AI deployment (Kubernetes, Docker), AI security (AWS Identity and Access Management, Google’s Secure AI Framework, Microsoft Copilot for Security). Once your team lacks some of these skills, cover the gap with FLEX on-demand developers.

Can you assist with the technical interviewing when I hire AI engineers?

Yes, we can. We engage niche Artificial Intelligence professionals to learn if your candidates know project-relevant tools and processes. Tech interviewers assess applicants’ problem-solving skills and craft test tasks. They provide reports with recommendations to help you pick the proper engineers.

How will your top AI developers for hire strengthen my tech team?

Mobilunity’s AI engineers for hire cover skill gaps in generative AI, security, deep learning, design, neural networks, prompt engineering, and many more fields of Artificial Intelligence.

When is it best to invest in Artificial Intelligence professionals?

Hire AI engineers when your project scope is ready or you need to customize an AI solution. Also, reach out for advice if you only think about how to boost data analysis, improve customer experience, optimize working processes, enhance security, or scale your business with Artificial Intelligence technologies.

How can I be sure that ML engineers from Mobilunity will deliver the expected result?

We find top-tier candidates who fit your tech requirements and working culture. Our retention policy ensures your ML coders stay committed, so you get your successful AI project completed on time.

We offer two approaches: a fixed monthly price and an effective daily rate (EDR). While the first option includes sick leaves and vacations, the other covers only days worked off, which makes it different from typical employment.

Finance, healthcare, chatbots, transportation, IoT, agriculture, manufacturing, marketing, customer service, e-commerce, entertainment, cyber security, energy, retail, education, legal advice, gaming, robotics, space exploration, and other industries use AI technology.
